name: a row of sellable product cards fans out with a fee badge
looks: Under a headline about selling in different ways, four small product cards (a download, a membership, a course, a call) fan into an even row, each its own colour with its own price, as a small starburst badge announcing no platform fee pops in beside them.
build: variant-stack-reveal: four DOM cards ease from a tighter cluster to an even row on staggered springs; the badge pops in on a quick rotate-and-scale (back.out) once the row settles.
sound: A soft cluster of card-settle ticks, a bright pop on the badge.
prompt: Fan out a small row of differently priced product cards (a download, a membership, a course, a session), each its own colour, from a tighter starting cluster into an even spread. Pop in a small badge beside them calling out a favourable term (no fee, free setup) once the row settles, as the clinching detail.
